facts.value: Unguarded CargoJump entry obtains the carrier Fighter, calls ftCommon_8007D5D4, changes motion to x2CC->x4_motion_state+7 with Ft_MF_None and animation arguments start=0, speed=1, blend=0, source=NULL, requests animation rate zero, calls ftCo_800CB110(gobj,true,1), and requests ShoulderedWait for victim_gobj. Where animation setup occurs, blend argument zero selects metadata default, not guaranteed zero effective blend; the transition initially computes cur_anim_frame=start-speed. Victim synchronization may be a no-op when already ShoulderedWait. CargoKneebend_Anim calls this entry when its canonical mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y field is <=0, then subtracts one even after entry; equating that field with cargokneebend.x8 requires compiled layout evidence.
